How to make one of these yours

1. Edit the profile

Everything lives in src/data/sites/ — one file per freelancer. Name, city, services, packages, process, testimonials, FAQ, projects and case studies all come from there.

2. Swap in real images

Drop files into src/assets/ using the names already referenced by each project. They are picked up automatically and optimised into responsive AVIF/WebP. Until then, on-brand SVG placeholders render instead.

3. Point the form somewhere

The contact form validates and shows a success state client-side. Wire it to Formspree, Netlify Forms or your own endpoint by setting the action in ContactForm.astro.
